description: Defines a template class for matrix operations supporting matrices with 2 to 4 rows/columns, including creation, multiplication, comparison, transpose, determinant, inverse, and identity functions. Also defines a specialized 4x4 matrix class with additional transformation methods.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: Template class implementing various matrix operations for matrices with size between 2 and 4.

classes.name: Mat4
classes.description: Derived class representing a 4x4 float matrix with additional transformation methods.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Access element at specified row and column.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Calculate matrix determinant for sizes 2, 3, or 4.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Compute matrix inverse for sizes 2, 3, or 4.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.description: Create rotation matrix around an axis.
